name: Suzuki Bandit 1200
engine: 1157 cc oil-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: A tough, cheap muscle bike. The engine lasts. Carbs, the regulator/rectifier and a worn second gear are things to check.

H: The tappets use screw and locknut adjusters, which makes valve checks easy.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Easy valves
known.what: The engines are tough and easy to service with screw and locknut tappets.
